# A per-head price isn't the whole quote.

> Free calculator for independent food truck and trailer operators: find the real price for one private event, catering, or festival booking after commissary prep, travel, staff labor, propane, permit fees, and turnout risk, then check a price you're already considering against the breakeven.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
